text:
maya: Quick thought for postmortem follow-ups — propose an "ownership signal grid" + small IC schedule tweak to reduce handoff gaps. Short plan: (1) 12-week ownership pulse, (2) 3-person handoff matrix (owner / fallback / escalation), (3) soft-standby IC for weekend coverage. Keen to pilot.

alex: Nice. Can you show the minimal grid fields? I want something filterable in the tracker.

maya: Sure, super compact:

```
remediation-id | owner | fallback | escalator | SLA days | reminder cadence | status | block link
RMD-2023       | alex  | sanjay   | oncall-md | 14       | 7/3/1            | open   | JIRA-234
```
All fields searchable, and we store a short regression-risk tag.

sanjay: Agree on compactness. For weekend coverage: let's not add extra rotations. Proposal: name a soft-standby IC who is reachable but only paged after automated checks and a primary triage. Rotate standby quarterly.

kelly: Add these action-item fields to postmortems: remediation-id, owner, severity, regression-risk, due-date, blockers, and a small notes field for why owner was chosen. Helps reviews and auditing.

jia: We can automate pings from incident-bot: DM owner at 48h and 24h before due-date and post weekly summary to #eng-oncall. Also incident-bot can tag overdue items and create a monthly recurring trend digest.

incident-bot: Reminder: watcher created for 'ownership-grid-pilot'. Automated pings (48h/24h) ready. PM to add Confluence template URL to enable full payload. :robot_face: 

alex: I'll be fallback for the pilot and help with the calendar invite for the soft-standby slots.

maya: Pilot timeline suggestion: week 0 = roll pilot to infra + api teams; week 3 = collect feedback + adjust reminders; week 6 = retro + decide expand. I'll own the pilot and run the retro.

kelly: Add a retro checkpoint 1 month after pilot ends to look for recurring incident patterns and ownership friction. Also track handoff latency metric (time between owner assignment and first update).

maya: Action items: maya: create Confluence template & update postmortem checklist; incident-bot: standby pings once template URL added; alex: fallback for pilot; kelly: schedule retro checkpoint + define handoff-latency metric; sanjay: advise on soft-standby rotation cadence. We'll reconvene next Monday in #eng-oncall for sign-off. :eyes:
